يقتلعون (form VIII)
# يَقْتَلِعُونَ (yaqtaliʕūna) /jaq.ta.li.ʕuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَلَعَ (iqtalaʕa)
# يُقْتَلَعُونَ (yuqtalaʕūna) /juq.ta.la.ʕuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَلَعَ (iqtalaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
